detail.longDescription: Coding with AI agents produces a lot of written artifacts: plans, specs, decisions, handoffs. Agents don't remember any of it between sessions, and ... neither do I. 😵‍💫 I needed a way to organize those notes and to actually read them, so I built an Astro-Starlight plugin for this. I named it Violet (after a Savage Garden song). Blog post with more details: https:// mariatta.ca/posts/violet-starl ight-plugin/ # AI # OpenSource # Astro # Starlight
